source: Public Kevin Xu (@kevinxu) rules: all-in one equity, no margin/options/crypto, swing 20–30%, don't chase, sell before rumor is fully news. LP overlay: no memes; prefer quality names the crowd overlooks.

rules.hardStopNote: Xu does not use stop-losses. Exit = thesis/setup dead, chase detected, or target hit. Fund-level halt still applies on 20% NAV drawdown.

setupChecklist: Real operating company (not meme, not penny, not crypto-proxy)
Crowd is looking elsewhere (overlooked vs already crowded run)
Near-term catalyst in days–weeks (product, print reaction window already passed, unlock, guidance, sector rotation) — not a 12-month activist story
Price near support / not extended after the move
Downside in a good stock is typically an ugly earnings gap (~20–25%), not zero
passIf: Already ran hard into the catalyst (chase)
Meme / squeeze narrative is the thesis
Needs options or leverage to work
Horizon is 3–12 months with no near-term swing
Would require a second simultaneous name
